'''2001 Minnesota State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Minnesota in 2001.<ref name="dt-15956">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15956 Bloody BHBM MN States deck], DeckTech (Justin "MoffWicket" Alfs, 14 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15956/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15956/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 12 May 2001<ref name="tr-d2297" />
* '''Site:''' Minnesota; Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota<ref name="tr-d2297" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joshua Grace]]<ref name="tr-d2297" />
* '''Players:''' 42<ref name="tr-d2297" />

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Alfs posted his Dark deck as the exact list he played at States, where it went undefeated; he also played Hidden Base mains there and won by 20.<ref name="dt-15956" /> Raveling finished runner-up. His Dark Bring Him Before Me deck went undefeated at States,<ref name="dt-15943" /> and he used his Light deck "in the final confrontation of Minnesota states"; it gave him the differential to get there.<ref name="dt-15962" />

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The hub's results table gives Justin Alfs's finish as 'Undefeated' (from his deck post, which says his Dark deck went undefeated); Joshua Grace's and Justin Alfs's own reports give Alfs 4th place at 4–2, losing to Grace and Michael Raveling.<ref name="tr-d2307" />
* The hub's results table gives Justin Alfs's finish as 'Undefeated' (from his deck post, which says his Dark deck went undefeated); Joshua Grace's and Justin Alfs's own reports give Alfs 4th place at 4–2, losing to Grace and Michael Raveling.<ref name="tr-d2302" />
